sqlConfig.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name::text AS label, project_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) options WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

SELECT DISTINCT customer_name::text AS label, customer_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) options WHERE customer_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

WITH b AS (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "租赁单数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_type=2) AS "加花单数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_type=3) AS "减花单数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_type=1) AS "换花单数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_type=4) AS "调花单数", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished THEN rent_change_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "租金变动净额" FROM b WHERE business_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND business_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND customer_name = {{customerName}}]] AND order_type IN (1,2,3,4)

sqlConfig.query: WITH b AS (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) SELECT project_name AS "项目", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished THEN rent_change_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "租金变动净额" FROM b WHERE business_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND business_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND customer_name = {{customerName}}]] AND order_type IN (1,2,3,4) GROUP BY project_name ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished THEN rent_change_amount END)::numeric,2) DESC LIMIT 15

WITH b AS (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) SELECT project_name AS "项目", COUNT(*) AS "租赁单数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_finished) AS "在途单数", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished THEN rent_change_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "租金变动净额", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_finished THEN order_cost_amount END)::numeric,2) AS "处理成本" FROM b WHERE business_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND business_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND customer_name = {{customerName}}]] AND order_type IN (1,2,3,4) GROUP BY project_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 100
